(HOVR) on August 31, 2026, with an EPS forecast of -0.12. The sources also mention Niu Technologies ADR (NIU) and Fast Retailing Co. Ltd. ADR (FRCOY) both scheduled for earnings on September 30, 2026, with forecasts of -0.15 and 0.19 respectively. The sources do not provide information on earnings for October 8, 2026.
